name: pokec
title: Pokec: who is influential, and where
description: Pokec social network: each row is a directed friendship from the first user to the second.

evidence.directed: 54.2% of rows are reciprocated: partial reciprocity is the signature of a directed graph; description says directed

steps.question: Who are the 10 most influential users?

turn.question: Who are the 10 most influential users?

interpretation.measure: PageRank on the directed friendship graph (influence = being named as a friend by users who are themselves widely named)

variants: in-degree (number of users who list this user as a friend)

steps.note: Directed PageRank. It is O(k(n+m)), which is feasible on 1.6M nodes and 30.6M arcs.
The 10 users with the highest PageRank.
Alternative measure: in-degree, the number of users who declare this user a friend.
Top 10 by in-degree, to check whether the choice of measure matters.

plan.rationale: Edges are directed friendship declarations, so incoming links signal recognition. PageRank captures recursive influence and is linear-cost on this very large graph. In-degree is a cheap, simple alternative shown alongside it. Betweenness and closeness were left out because they are O(nm) at this size.

findings.detail: overlap@k=0.90; measures agree on the leaders

turn.explanation: By PageRank, the 10 most influential users are 5935 (0.000383), 5867 (0.000176), 1891 (0.000163), 6228, 8413, 57918, 27509, 1830, 25994 and 59973 (0.0000412). PageRank was computed exactly on the full directed, unweighted friendship graph of 1,632,803 users, with damping 0.85 and no restriction to the largest component. A user counts as influential when they are named as a friend by users who are themselves widely named. As a simpler cross-check, in-degree (how many users name someone as a friend) puts the same top four in front, led by 5935 with 13,733 incoming links. The two lists share 9 of their 10 users: user 27509 ranks only in the PageRank top 10, and user 86306 (1,413 incoming links) ranks only in the in-degree top 10. Verification found no problems: the PageRank scores sum to 1, and the 90% overlap shows the two measures agree on the leaders.

turn.explanation: Most of the top 10 by PageRank are from the Bratislava region. Node 5935 is from Bratislava - Ruzinov; nodes 5867, 1891 and 6228 are from Bratislava - Stare Mesto; and nodes 25994 and 59973 are from Bratislava - Petrzalka. The rest are spread out: 8413 and 57918 are from Zilina (Zilinsky kraj), 27509 is from Nitra (Nitriansky kraj), and 1830 is listed as abroad, "zahranicie - gb". The in-degree top 10 shares nine of these nodes; the one difference is node 86306 from Kosice - Zapad (Kosicky kraj) in place of 27509. These are the turn-1 rankings reused unchanged (PageRank with damping 0.85 and in-degree, on the full directed, unweighted friendship graph) joined with the "region" node attribute, which covers 99.99% of nodes. Checks found no problems: PageRank sums to 1, and the two measures agree on 9 of the 10 leaders.

The plan's rationale said it would reuse the whole-network scores from turn 1, but that is not what ran. PageRank (damping 0.85, directed, unweighted) was recomputed on the region's own subgraph of 61,571 users and 81,517 links, so only friendships inside the region count, and influence from users elsewhere in Pokec is ignored. turns.explanation: Ranked by PageRank, the 10 most influential users in region "zahranicie, zahranicie - ostatne" are 392119 (2.112e-05), 1197592 (1.764e-05), 162251 (1.599e-05), 151866 (1.597e-05), 371303 (1.540e-05), 296091 (1.510e-05), 228853 (1.467e-05), 41692 (1.292e-05), 283698 (1.170e-05) and 381654 (1.163e-05). PageRank (damping 0.85) was computed exactly, not approximated, on the whole directed, unweighted Pokec friendship graph of 1,632,803 users, with no restriction to the largest component, and the PageRank values sum to 1. The scores were then filtered to the region's 61,571 users. This means influence includes friendships from anywhere in the network, not only from within the region. Treat the ranking with some caution: by raw in-degree (how many users name them as a friend), only three of these users stay in the top 10, namely 392119 (622), 228853 (617) and 371303 (519). The rest of the in-degree top 10 are 56688, 19171, 176985, 133138, 226036, 85750 and 172086, so the two measures disagree substantially.

By in-degree (how many times a user is named as a friend), the leader is 282492 with 242, then 251164 (231), 325985 (228), 72980 (221) and 234898 (215). The two rankings share five of their top-10 users, including the top four. The other five differ: 233345, 339044, 69135, 155121 and 326933 rank high only on PageRank, while 485010, 109173, 359165, 134502 and 240886 rank high only on in-degree. As in the earlier turns, both scores were computed only on links between Nitra users (55,215 users and 480,269 directed, unweighted friendship links), so connections to people outside the region don't count. PageRank was computed exactly with damping 0.85, not approximated, and the scores passed the sum-to-1 check.

plan.rationale: The question names PageRank explicitly, so no alternative measure is needed. The plan sums the whole-graph PageRank from turn 1 over each region with group_by_attribute and reads the top 5 rows of the sorted table. This compares regions rather than restricting the measure to one group. Per-region subgraph PageRank (the reading B chosen earlier) would make every region's total equal to 1, so global scores are the only meaningful reading here.

turns.explanation: The 5 regions with the highest total PageRank are "zahranicie, zahranicie - ostatne" (sum ≈ 0.0332, 61,571 nodes), "nitriansky kraj, nitra" (≈ 0.0320, 55,215 nodes), "zilinsky kraj, zilina" (≈ 0.0302, 50,053 nodes), "presovsky kraj, presov" (≈ 0.0293, 47,928 nodes), and "banskobystricky kraj, banska bystrica" (≈ 0.0240, 46,984 nodes). These come from PageRank with damping 0.85 on the whole directed, unweighted friendship graph of 1,632,803 nodes, reused from turn 1 and not limited to the largest component. Each node's global score was summed within its region, and the top 5 of 187 regions were taken. Per-region subgraph PageRank was not used because every region's total would then equal 1. The PageRank scores were checked and sum to 1, and no approximation was involved.
